facts.text: Undergraduates in St. John's Discover the World: Europe program spend a semester studying across three cities: Rome, Paris, and Seville.

sources.title: St. John's Ranked 31st Nationally for Study Abroad Programs by ...
sources.quote: The university's innovative Discover the World: Europe program allows students from various disciplines to spend a semester engaged in comparative education, learning from local faculty in three essential European cities – Rome, Paris and Seville, Spain.
